RT by @DXBMediaOffice: The agreement between Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC (DIB) and Emirates NBD Bank PJSC (Emirates NBD) for DIB to acquire Emirates Islamic Bank PJSC marks a significant step in strengthening Dubai's position as a global centre for Islamic finance. On completion, the combined group is expected to have total assets of approximately AED 585 billion, reinforcing DIB's position as the UAE's largest Islamic banking group. Bringing together two complementary Islamic banking franchises will strengthen the group's ability to serve customers and support the UAE's economic ambitions.
